title: Voice session page fixed: Overview/Timeline/Tasks/Board/Coverage, the sliver, and the More dropdown

owner_note.text: Every voice session's page (the id looks like "v-9dvbbrn", not a uuid) was stuck: the page's own code only loaded its tasks and stats once it saw a uuid-shaped id, so for a voice session that check always failed and nothing ever loaded. Fixed and merged to michael/dev; also fixed the More dropdown (a ux/Popover menu — it's the one you like the look of) not closing on a second tap, a one-line browser-API quirk in the same widget used elsewhere on these pages.

message.text: Every voice session's page (the id looks like "v-9dvbbrn", not a uuid) was stuck: the page's own code only loaded its tasks and stats once it saw a uuid-shaped id, so for a voice session that check always failed and nothing ever loaded. Landed and the task's landing line is written (commits f4e929097, d04b90a56 on michael/dev). Follow-up on this same session page: the Overview's sort button is now a clear Cost/Newest toggle with "Child sessions (4)" instead of the wrong "N tasks drawn"; the sticky white sliver above the tabs is gone (a CSS [hidden] bug); the /ai-logs 400 in the console is gone; the Timeline names "chat" and "plumbing" instead of an unexplained "other lines" bucket and says how many events are hidden by Filters; and the raw p-/q- ids under "Other work" now show your own words, linked to their Timeline row. Landed on michael/dev, reviewed, tests pass.

Still open, held for your go-ahead: making Chat the first tab, dropping Prompt/Question records from the "Other work" task count, and redesigning the Tasks tab (grouped by state, a Waiting-on-you row).
